text:
cs_jordan: FYI — Acme's ingest pipeline started failing after yesterday's canary (canary-2026-03-11). Their parser expects a root object but model responses are now wrapped in a top-level array. Example (what they used to get):
```
{ "order_id": 1234, "items": [ ... ] }
```
Now they get:
```
[ { "order_id": 1234, "items": [ ... ] } ]
```
They say it's happening across all routes using model redwood-llama-13b:v2. Ticket #ACME-438. Can we triage? :urgent:

ingrid_dataops: Can you paste the exact request id and model variant? Any request_ts / response bytes? I want to repro. Also did the canary include any middleware changes (streaming/formatters)?

cs_jordan: ReqID: req_0x9f7c2a. Model header from their logs: model: redwood-llama-13b:v2, runtime: host-2026-03-11-canary. Product mentioned they toggled "structured_output_strictness" for the canary but no explicit formatter changes in release notes.

alice_prodeng: Assigning to eng-oncall. @eng_oncall_bot please take a look. If we can reproduce, consider rolling the canary back. Also share the exact cURL they used.

cs_jordan: cURL snippet:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-llama-13b:v2","input":"Summarize order ...","structured_output":true}'
```
Response body starts with `[` on all failing requests.

eng_oncall_bot: Oncall assigned to alice_prodeng. I'll run a quick smoke test against canary.

ingrid_dataops: I repro locally using the same payload against the canary host (host-2026-03-11). Sample returned:
```
[
  {"order_id":1234,"items":[{"sku":"X","qty":1}]}
]
```
Production (non-canary) returns object as expected. So this is limited to canary.

alice_prodeng: Thanks — this matches. Hypothesis: streaming post-processor that normalizes chunk boundaries is erroneously wrapping top-level object in an array when it detects repeated object-fragment tokens. I'll look at the sanitizer commit from Mar 11. If confirmed, we should rollback the canary and hotfix.

ingrid_dataops: Found offending change: commit 4b7e3a toggled "wrap_root_for_streaming" to true in the canary branch. That flag was intended only for multi-root responses, but it's being applied to single-root responses. Reverting flag locally fixes output. Pushing rollback to canary now.

cs_jordan: :thumbsup: Can you also confirm customer parser recovers? I'll tell Acme to re-test once we flip.

alice_prodeng: Rollback applied to canary at 1860000005, rolling to prod shortly. I'll monitor telemetry for malformed JSON errors (parser-error-rate).

ingrid_dataops: Monitoring — malformed-json error-rate back to baseline in canary. Prod rollback complete at 1860001370.

cs_jordan: Acme confirmed ingestion normal again. Ticket #ACME-438 marked resolved. Please add a unit/integration test for top-level-response-wrapping to prevent regression. Thanks all :tada:
